== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The oracle [[codex]] is a sophisticated calculation device owned by [[Northstrider]]. It manifests as a gleaming, [[reflective black orb]] that can appear over his shoulder or be accessed through his [[soulspace]]. Rather than being a sentient person, the [[codex]] functions as an advanced analytical tool used to process vast amounts of information, organize data, and provide simulations. It assists [[Northstrider]] by offering predictions regarding the actions of [[Dreadgods]], analyzing various possibilities within [[Fate]], and compiling complex data such as spatial transport ranges or information regarding the [[Abidan]] divisions. The device can also issue warnings, report on compatibility scores, and communicate through text or messages that may mimic the voice of [[Dross]]. [[Northstrider]] utilizes the [[codex]] to refine his ability to see the future and to supplement his analysis of complex situations.}}
